messages:
Samir: Heads-up — I'm proposing an audit event field change for identity events. Need alignment on versioning, KMS metadata, and RBAC implications before we push.

Olivia: high level — what's being added/removed? any PII risk? :eyes:

Samir: plan is to add `actor_ip` and `kms_key_id`, remove `legacy_user_id` (we've deprecated that ID for a while). Also add `auth_method` enum (oauth|apikey|sso). No new PII except `actor_ip` which is already captured in other telemetry but we want it in the audit event for forensics.

Alex: quick note on consumers — internal analytics/summaries rely on `legacy_user_id` today for a few migration queries. We should provide a compatibility shim or mapping for 3 months. I suggest bumping `audit_event_schema` to 3 and emitting `legacy_user_id` as `legacy_user_id:null` for one release before removing.

Jess: CS note — any customer-visible change? Customers who ingest audit events will break if we remove fields. We need a migration notice and example event payloads.

Samir: agreed. Draft rollout timeline:
- t+0: feature branch and decoder/encoder changes, add `schema_version: 3` to emitted events
- t+7: internal dogfood and storage-level compatibility tests
- t+21: announce public deprecation (30 days) + provide shim in hosted API: `legacy_user_id` until t+90
- t+90: remove shim, hard cutoff

Olivia: RBAC implications — adding `kms_key_id` to the audit event means key identifiers will be visible in logs. Confirm that 1) we do not emit sensitive ciphertext, 2) KMS key IDs are allowed to be logged by policy. If not, we need to redact or hash the key id. Suggest we allow logging only the suffix (last 8 chars) to balance forensics and privacy.

Samir: good call. Proposal: emit `kms_key_id_suffix` (last 8 chars) instead of full id. Add a `kms_access_granted` boolean for quick checks. Will update spec.

Alex: on the infra side — we need validators in ingest to accept both v2 and v3 formats. Sketch of decoder logic:
```
if event.schema_version == 2:
  map legacy_user_id -> user_id
elif event.schema_version == 3:
  required: user_id, actor_ip, auth_method, kms_key_id_suffix
```
Also add a warning metric for v2->v3 mismatches.

Olivia: vuln/attack surface — `actor_ip` can be abused if customers rely on these logs for network controls. We should document retention and access controls (only sec/audit role). Also update RBAC so only `auditor` role and above can query raw audit events. Lower roles can see aggregated counts.

Jess: customer comms — I'll prepare compliant example payloads and migration steps. Need a contact list for large customers we should notify individually.

infra-bot: Deploy check passed for branch "audit-schema-v3" — lint: ok, unit: 48/49, integration: running

Samir: next actions:
- Olivia: update security policy text and decide on kms id truncation (due EOD)
- Alex: implement decoder tolerant parsing + metrics (due 1 week)
- Jess: draft customer migration email and example payloads (due 3 days)
- Samir: open PR with schema doc and sample event (due today)

Olivia: ack. I'll propose `kms_key_id_suffix` + a short rationale in the doc. Also will add RBAC rule: `role:auditor` required for `audit.events.read` API.

Alex: ack. Will add a feature flag to gate `schema_version:3` in prod for gradual rollout.

Samir: thanks. I'll ping infra & CS when PR is up. If anyone sees downstream consumers we missed, drop them here. :pray:
